content:
name: Orchid Continuous Completion

# Canonical scheduler. Compatibility entrypoints delegate here; Portfolio
# Steward remains a separate queue-planning role, outside implementation capacity.
on:
  # Scheduled launches paused pending recovery from runner nonexecution.
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review, closed]
  issues:
    types: [closed, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: read
  pull-requests: read
  actions: read

env:
  MAX_ACTIVE_LANES: 8
  PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: 'true'

jobs:
  reconcile:
    name: Reconcile expired leases against hosted run evidence
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: orchid-lease-reconciliation-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts reconcile

  supervisor:
    name: Discover governed work and refill the bounded reservoir
    needs: reconcile
    if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' &&
      (needs.reconcile.result == 'success' || needs.reconcile.result == 'skipped')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    concurrency:
      group: orchid-supervisor-discovery-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Scan Brain, backend, frontend, graph, and governed issue state
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: 'false'
          # Admit the Calyx evidence-gap reserve plan (GET
          # /api/runner/knowledge-gaps/reserve-plan): at most 3 bounded,
          # review-required research missions per pass, no publication, no KG or
          # taxonomy mutation, locality-gated domains excluded. Fails closed and
          # files nothing when the backend plan is unavailable.
          OC_ADMIT_BACKEND_RESERVE: '1'
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-supervisor-discovery.ts
      - name: Preserve the durable supervisor discovery packet
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-supervisor-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .oc-wave/supervisor-discovery.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  plan:
    needs: [reconcile, supervisor]
    if: always() &&
      (needs.reconcile.result == 'success' || needs.reconcile.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.supervisor.result == 'success' || needs.supervisor.result == 'skipped')
    name: Graph admission and shared wave
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: orchid-dispatch-plan-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    outputs:
      issues: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.issues }}
      wave_hash: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.wave_hash }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Read complete inventory and rank canonical graph leaves
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          # The provider policy each lane's budget-preflight applies, mirrored
          # (never widened) so the plan admits provider-lane issues only up to
          # the slots that policy and the durable ledger can actually grant.
          # Pinned equal to orchid-budgeted-completion-lane.yml by test.
          OC_PROVIDER_NO_API_MODE: 'false'
          OC_PROVIDER_DISABLED: ''
          OC_PROVIDER_DAILY_MAX_CALLS: '4'
          OC_PROVIDER_WAVE_MAX_CALLS: '1'
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts plan
      - name: Preserve hash-addressed shared context
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-wave-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .oc-wave/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  # A pull_request run is plan-only: it proves the admission plan on the PR's
  # head, but never reserves leases, relabels issues or runs lanes against the
  # live queue and ledger. On 2026-09-25 the PR #821 run executed issue #816
  # from unmerged code. Scheduled, issue-event and manual runs dispatch.
  dispatch:
    needs: plan
    if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' &&
      needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.issues != '[]'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/orchid-deterministic-dispatch.yml
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      issues_json: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.issues }}
      wave_hash: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.wave_hash }}
      artifact_name: oc-wave-${{ github.run_attempt }}

  audit:
    name: Reconcile admitted plan with lane receipts
    needs: [plan, dispatch]
    if: always() && github.event_name != 'pull_request' &&
      needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.issues != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: oc-wave-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: oc-lane-${{ github.run_attempt }}-*
          path: .oc-receipts
          merge-multiple: true
      - env:
          OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.wave_hash }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts audit

name: Orchid NO-API Scheduler

# Backward-compatible manual entrypoint; only the canonical workflow schedules ticks.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  canonical:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/orchid-continuous-completion.yml

name: Orchid Budgeted Completion Lane

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        required: true
        type: string
      wave_hash:
        required: true
        type: string
      artifact_name:
        required: true
        type: string
      provider_authorized:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      requested_usd:
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 0.50

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: orchid-governed-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Routing decides before the provider preflight runs, so only the lane that
  # did not execute can ever write a `provider_not_authorized` receipt.
  classify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      provider_free: ${{ steps.route.outputs.provider_free }}
      commands: ${{ steps.route.outputs.commands }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Route this issue by declared capability
        id: route
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: node scripts/oc-provider-free-route.mjs

  budget-preflight:
    needs: classify
    if: needs.classify.outputs.provider_free != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      allowed: ${{ steps.budget.outputs.allowed }}
      lease_id: ${{ steps.budget.outputs.lease_id }}
    env:
      ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: ${{ inputs.provider_authorized }}
      REQUESTED_USD: ${{ inputs.requested_usd }}
      OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
      OC_PROVIDER_NO_API_MODE: 'false'
      OC_PROVIDER_DISABLED: ''
      OC_PROVIDER_DAILY_MAX_CALLS: '4'
      OC_PROVIDER_WAVE_MAX_CALLS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - name: Preserve existing provider policy, throttles and fingerprints
        id: policy
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/provider-governor-workflow-gate.ts
      - name: Fail-closed budget and exclusive durable reservation
        id: budget
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OC_PROVIDER_POLICY_ALLOWED: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.allow_paid_execution }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts admit
      - name: Preserve denied-lane receipt
        if: steps.budget.outputs.allowed == 'false'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-lane-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-receipts/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  # Deterministic work does not need, and must not wait for, provider
  # authorization. It still takes a lease, so unchanged work is not run again on
  # the next pulse: the fingerprint check lives behind the provider gate in
  # `claimLease`, which is why #171 executed three times in four minutes.
  deterministic-preflight:
    needs: classify
    if: needs.classify.outputs.provider_free == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Declared, not inherited. Without this the job picks up the workflow-level
    # `actions: write` and `id-token: write` it has no use for. It reads the plan
    # and writes the ledger branch and a refusal label, and nothing else.
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
    outputs:
      allowed: ${{ steps.lease.outputs.allowed }}
      lease_id: ${{ steps.lease.outputs.lease_id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - name: Reserve a zero-cost lane and refuse unchanged work
        id: lease
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts admit-deterministic
      - name: Preserve the not-executed receipt
        if: steps.lease.outputs.allowed == 'false'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-lane-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-receipts/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  provider-free-worker:
    needs: [classify, deterministic-preflight]
    if: needs.deterministic-preflight.outputs.allowed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
      EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
      COMMANDS: ${{ needs.classify.outputs.commands }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      # The browser route sentinel is a deterministic capability, but the
      # Playwright package does not download Chromium during npm ci. Install
      # only the browser that this declared command needs; no provider or
      # external model is involved.
      - name: Install Chromium for browser route verification
        if: contains(needs.classify.outputs.commands, 'npm run verify:routes') || contains(needs.classify.outputs.commands, 'npm run verify:featured-genus') || contains(needs.classify.outputs.commands, 'browser')
        run: npx --no-install playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Build and start preview for browser route verification
        if: contains(needs.classify.outputs.commands, 'npm run verify:routes')
        run: |
          npm run build
          nohup npx --no-install vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 >/tmp/oc-vite-preview.log 2>&1 &
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4173/ >/dev/null; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          cat /tmp/oc-vite-preview.log
          exit 1
      # No provider secret is present in this job, and none is forwarded to it.
      # The commands are chosen from a fixed registry, never from issue text.
      - name: Execute declared deterministic capabilities
        run: node scripts/oc-provider-free-execute.mjs
      - name: Preserve execution evidence for settlement
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-evidence-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-evidence/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # The one authoritative receipt for a deterministic lane, written by the job
  # that can tell whether execution actually happened.
  settle-deterministic:
    needs: [deterministic-preflight, provider-free-worker]
    if: always() && needs.deterministic-preflight.outputs.lease_id != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: oc-evidence-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-evidence
      - name: Settle the deterministic lane against its evidence
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          OC_LEASE_ID: ${{ needs.deterministic-preflight.outputs.lease_id }}
          OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
          EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts settle-deterministic
      # `always()`, so a settlement that throws still leaves the audit a receipt
      # rather than an unexplained gap and a lane held until the lease expires.
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-lane-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-receipts/*.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  provider-worker:
    needs: budget-preflight
    if: inputs.provider_authorized && needs.budget-preflight.outputs.allowed == 'true' && needs.budget-preflight.outputs.lease_id != ''
    uses: ./.github/workflows/orchid-completion-lane.yml
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      issue_number: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      provider_authorized: ${{ inputs.provider_authorized }}
      lease_id: ${{ needs.budget-preflight.outputs.lease_id }}
      wave_hash: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
      artifact_name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
    # Owner-authorized provider secrets are forwarded only into the governed implementation worker.

  settle:
    needs: [budget-preflight, provider-worker]
    if: always() && needs.budget-preflight.outputs.lease_id != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - name: Release fenced lease and immediately refill this capacity
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          OC_LEASE_ID: ${{ needs.budget-preflight.outputs.lease_id }}
          OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts settle
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: oc-lane-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          path: .oc-receipts/*.json
          # upload-artifact v4 drops dot-directories unless told otherwise; without
          # this the settle receipt never reached the audit (run 36230834756).
          include-hidden-files: true

name: Orchid Completion Lane

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        required: true
        type: string
      provider_authorized:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      lease_id:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      wave_hash:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      artifact_name:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

concurrency:
  group: orchid-completion-lane-${{ github.repository }}-${{ inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  budget-authorization:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      allowed: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.allowed }}
      integration_sha: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.integration_sha }}
    env:
      ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: ${{ inputs.provider_authorized }}
      OC_LEASE_ID: ${{ inputs.lease_id }}
      OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
      OC_PROVIDER_NO_API_MODE: 'false'
      OC_PROVIDER_DISABLED: ''
      OC_PROVIDER_DAILY_MAX_CALLS: '4'
      OC_PROVIDER_WAVE_MAX_CALLS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check authorization even for a direct legacy caller
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/oc-budget-governor.mjs --authorized "$PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED" > budget-decision.json || test "$?" -eq 42
          cat budget-decision.json
      - id: policy
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/provider-governor-workflow-gate.ts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        if: inputs.provider_authorized && inputs.artifact_name != ''
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - name: Verify fenced reservation and current admission before real worker
        id: verify
        if: inputs.provider_authorized && inputs.lease_id != '' && inputs.artifact_name != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OC_PROVIDER_POLICY_ALLOWED: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.allow_paid_execution }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts verify

  execute:
    needs: budget-authorization
    if: inputs.provider_authorized && needs.budget-authorization.outputs.allowed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    env:
      ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      INTEGRATION_BRANCH: oc-autonomous-integration
    steps:
      - name: Checkout caller control implementation
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave
      - name: Start fenced lease from actual executable lane
        id: lease
        env:
          PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED: ${{ inputs.provider_authorized }}
          OC_PROVIDER_POLICY_ALLOWED: ${{ needs.budget-authorization.outputs.allowed }}
          OC_LEASE_ID: ${{ inputs.lease_id }}
          OC_WAVE_HASH: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
        run: npx --no-install tsx scripts/oc-dispatch-runtime.ts start
      - name: Checkout admitted integration revision
        if: steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.budget-authorization.outputs.integration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Reuse admitted wave context
        if: steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .oc-wave

      - name: Load issue context
        if: steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        id: issue
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          title=$(gh issue view "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json title --jq '.title')
          body=$(gh issue view "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq '.body')
          {
            echo 'title<<EOF'
            echo "$title"
            echo EOF
            echo 'body<<EOF'
            echo "$body"
            echo EOF
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Completion worker started; provider order=Claude→Gemini→OpenAI. Run ${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}." >/dev/null

      - name: Resolve durable PR lineage
        if: steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        id: lineage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          marker="OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          pr=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --base "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH" --limit 100 --json number,body --jq ".[] | select(.body != null and (.body | contains(\"$marker\"))) | .number" || true)
          pr=${pr%%$'\n'*}
          if [[ -n "$pr" ]]; then
            branch=$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json headRefName --jq '.headRefName')
            echo "existing_pr=$pr" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "branch=$branch" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "existing_pr=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "branch=oc-auto-${ISSUE_NUMBER}-fallback-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Execute issue with Claude Code
        if: steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        id: claude
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@c81e3bc69d1b18badbb63ba39581218f02421678 # v1.0.201
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          github_token: ${{ github.token }}
          prompt: |
            ORCHID CONTINUUM — CONTINUOUS COMPLETION LANE

            Repository: ${{ github.repository }}
            Integration base: oc-autonomous-integration
            Source issue: #${{ inputs.issue_number }} — ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}

            Issue requirements:
            ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}

            EXECUTE BEFORE EXPLAINING. This is one lane in a continuously refilling multi-lane completion system.

            Rules:
            - Start from the current `oc-autonomous-integration` branch, then inspect current `main` and overlapping PRs before editing; converge rather than duplicate.
            - If an open PR already contains `OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${{ inputs.issue_number }}`, update that same PR/branch instead of creating another.
            - Implement the largest safe bounded vertical slice that can be completed in this run.
            - Use real Continuum data/contracts; unavailable != absent; do not invent scientific evidence.
            - Run focused tests, broader tests, lint, typecheck/build and browser/preview validation where appropriate; repair failures before delivery.
            - Read .oc-wave/plan.json and its hash-addressed wave packet first; reuse shared governance, architecture, graph and lineage context.
            - Commit and push durable work. Open/update exactly one draft PR targeting `oc-autonomous-integration` and include these exact machine-readable lines in its body:
              `OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${{ inputs.issue_number }}`
              `OC-AUTO-REQUEUE: true|false`
              `OC-AUTO-BLOCKED: true|false`
            - If the entire issue cannot fit in one run, deliver a coherent working slice and record explicit remaining acceptance items; never return only an audit or plan.
            - Never merge to `main`, deploy production, mutate production DB/KG/scientific state, activate taxonomy, publish science, create/disclose credentials, spend funds, force-push, or delete branches/repos.
            - Final output: DONE, VALIDATION, PR/HEAD SHA, REMAINING, OWNER GATE if any.
          claude_args: |
            --model claude-sonnet-5
            --max-turns 75
            --allowedTools "Edit,Read,Write,Bash(git diff:*),Bash(git status:*),Bash(git ls-files:*),Bash(git log:*),Bash(git rev-parse:*),Bash(git add:*),Bash(git commit:*),Bash(git push:*),Bash(git checkout:*),Bash(git switch:*),Bash(git branch:*),Bash(git fetch:*),Bash(git merge:*),Bash(npm:*),Bash(npx:*),Bash(test:*),Bash(gh pr:*),Bash(gh issue:*)"
            --append-system-prompt "Read CLAUDE.md and repository instructions before editing. Orchid Continuum Brain and GitHub are authoritative. BLOCKED DOES NOT MEAN STOPPED FOR THE PROGRAM. Deliver durable GitHub work, never runner-local-only claims. Preserve taxonomy, provenance, uncertainty and sensitive-locality rules."

      - name: Diagnose the Claude run
        if: always() && steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/diagnose-claude-run.mjs

      - name: Classify Claude terminal state
        if: always() && steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        id: claude_provider
        env:
          CLAUDE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.claude.outcome }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          execution_log="/home/runner/work/_temp/claude-execution-output.json"
          normalized=""
          log_present=false
          if [[ -f "$execution_log" ]]; then
            log_present=true
            normalized=$(jq -r '[.. | strings] | join(" ")' "$execution_log" 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' || true)
          fi
          kind=healthy
          fallback=false
          if [[ "$CLAUDE_OUTCOME" == "success" && "$log_present" != "true" ]]; then
            kind=runtime_config
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
            if [[ "$normalized" == *"error_max_turns"* || "$normalized" == *"max_turns"* || "$normalized" == *"max turns"* || "$normalized" == *"maximum turns"* ]]; then
              kind=max_turns
            elif [[ "$normalized" == *"authentication"* || "$normalized" == *"unauthorized"* || "$normalized" == *"forbidden"* || "$normalized" == *"permission"* || "$normalized" == *"invalid api key"* || "$normalized" == *"invalid_api_key"* ]]; then
              kind=security
            elif [[ "$normalized" == *"billing_error"* || "$normalized" == *"credit balance"* || "$normalized" == *"insufficient credit"* || "$normalized" == *"rate_limit"* || "$normalized" == *"rate limit"* || "$normalized" == *"overloaded"* || "$normalized" == *"service unavailable"* || "$normalized" == *"connection_error"* || "$normalized" == *"timeout"* ]]; then
              kind=safe_provider
              fallback=true
            else
              kind=unknown
            fi
          fi
          {
            echo "kind=$kind"
            echo "fallback_allowed=$fallback"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Claude classification: kind=$kind fallback_allowed=$fallback execution_log=$log_present"

      - name: Execute bounded Gemini fallback
        if: steps.claude_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed == 'true'
        id: gemini
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
          WORK_BRANCH: ${{ steps.lineage.outputs.branch }}
          EXISTING_PR: ${{ steps.lineage.outputs.existing_pr }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-stderr.log"
          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-result.json"
          if [[ -z "${GEMINI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
            echo "config_missing" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-status.txt"
            exit 20
          fi

          if [[ -n "${EXISTING_PR:-}" ]]; then
            git fetch origin "$WORK_BRANCH"
            git checkout -B "$WORK_BRANCH" "origin/$WORK_BRANCH"
          else
            git checkout -B "$WORK_BRANCH" "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH"
          fi
          git config user.name "orchid-continuum-orchestrator[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          prompt=$(cat <<EOF
          ORCHID CONTINUUM — GOVERNED GEMINI FALLBACK

          Claude was safely classified unavailable. Implement the largest safe coherent repository-local slice for issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}: ${ISSUE_TITLE}.

          ${ISSUE_BODY}

          EDIT FILES ONLY. Do not use shell tools. Do not create commits, branches, pull requests, issues, releases, deployments, credentials, or external publications; the workflow owns packaging. Preserve taxonomy, provenance, uncertainty, sensitive-locality protections, unavailable-vs-zero semantics, scientific review boundaries, tests, security checks, governance, and owner gates. Never invent science. Do not mutate production data, activate taxonomy, publish science, spend funds, or perform destructive operations.
          EOF
          )

          gemini_home="$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-home"
          mkdir -p "$gemini_home/.gemini"
          cat > "$gemini_home/.gemini/settings.json" <<'JSON'
          {
            "tools": {
              "exclude": ["run_shell_command"]
            }
          }
          JSON

          set +e
          HOME="$gemini_home" env -u GH_TOKEN GEMINI_API_KEY="$GEMINI_API_KEY" GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true \
            timeout 35m npx -y @google/gemini-cli@latest \
            --approval-mode auto_edit --output-format json -p "$prompt" \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-result.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-stderr.log"
          status=$?
          set -e
          echo "$status" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-exit.txt"

          if ! git diff --quiet || [[ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]]; then
            git diff --check
            git add -A
            git commit -m "feat(auto): Gemini fallback slice for #${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
            git push origin "HEAD:$WORK_BRANCH"
            if [[ -z "${EXISTING_PR:-}" ]]; then
              body=$(cat <<EOF
          Governed Gemini fallback slice after Claude safe-provider failure.

          Provider: Gemini fallback
          Claude classification: ${{ steps.claude_provider.outputs.kind }}
          Gemini exit status: ${status}

          Independent exact-head validation remains mandatory. No production mutation, taxonomy activation, scientific publication, sensitive-locality relaxation, credential change, spending action, or destructive operation was authorized.

          OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${ISSUE_NUMBER}
          OC-AUTO-REQUEUE: true
          OC-AUTO-BLOCKED: false
          EOF
              )
              gh pr create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --base "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH" --head "$WORK_BRANCH" --draft --title "Gemini fallback: #${ISSUE_NUMBER} ${ISSUE_TITLE}" --body "$body" >/dev/null
            fi
            exit 0
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Classify Gemini terminal state
        if: always() && steps.claude_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed == 'true'
        id: gemini_provider
        env:
          GEMINI_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.gemini.outcome }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          kind=healthy
          fallback=false
          if [[ "$GEMINI_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
            if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-status.txt" ]] && grep -q 'config_missing' "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-status.txt"; then
              kind=config
            elif grep -Eqi '401|403|unauthor|forbidden|invalid.?api.?key|authentication|permission' "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-stderr.log" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-result.json" 2>/dev/null; then
              kind=security
            elif grep -Eqi '429|quota|rate.?limit|billing|credit|overloaded|service unavailable|temporarily unavailable|timeout|timed out|connection' "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-stderr.log" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-result.json" 2>/dev/null || [[ "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/gemini-exit.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)" == "124" ]]; then
              kind=safe_provider
              fallback=true
            else
              kind=unknown
            fi
          fi
          {
            echo "kind=$kind"
            echo "fallback_allowed=$fallback"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Gemini classification: kind=$kind fallback_allowed=$fallback"

      - name: Execute bounded OpenAI fallback
        if: steps.gemini_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed == 'true'
        id: openai
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
          WORK_BRANCH: ${{ steps.lineage.outputs.branch }}
          EXISTING_PR: ${{ steps.lineage.outputs.existing_pr }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stdout.log"
          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stderr.log"
          if [[ -z "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
            echo "config_missing" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-status.txt"
            exit 20
          fi

          if [[ -n "${EXISTING_PR:-}" ]]; then
            git fetch origin "$WORK_BRANCH"
            git checkout -B "$WORK_BRANCH" "origin/$WORK_BRANCH"
          else
            git checkout -B "$WORK_BRANCH" "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH"
          fi
          git config user.name "orchid-continuum-orchestrator[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          prompt=$(cat <<EOF
          ORCHID CONTINUUM — GOVERNED OPENAI SECOND FALLBACK

          Claude and Gemini were both safely classified unavailable for provider-capacity reasons. Implement the largest safe coherent repository-local slice for issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}: ${ISSUE_TITLE}.

          ${ISSUE_BODY}

          Work only inside the checked-out repository. Do not use git or gh and do not access network resources from model-generated commands. Do not create commits, branches, pull requests, issues, releases, deployments, credentials, or external publications; the workflow owns packaging. Preserve taxonomy, provenance, uncertainty, sensitive-locality protections, unavailable-vs-zero semantics, scientific review boundaries, tests, security checks, governance, and owner gates. Never invent science. Do not mutate production data, activate taxonomy, publish science, spend funds, or perform destructive operations. You may inspect/edit repository files and run local tests within the workspace sandbox.
          EOF
          )

          git config --local --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader 2>/dev/null || true
          export CODEX_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/codex-home"
          mkdir -p "$CODEX_HOME"
          set +e
          printf '%s\n' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" | npx -y @openai/codex@0.151.0 login --with-api-key \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-login.log" 2>> "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stderr.log"
          login_status=$?
          if [[ "$login_status" -eq 0 ]]; then
            env -u GH_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY="$OPENAI_API_KEY" CODEX_HOME="$CODEX_HOME" timeout 35m \
              npx -y @openai/codex@0.151.0 --ask-for-approval never exec \
              --sandbox workspace-write --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$prompt" \
              > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stdout.log" 2>> "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stderr.log"
            status=$?
          else
            status=$login_status
          fi
          set -e
          echo "$status" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-exit.txt"
          gh auth setup-git >/dev/null

          if ! git diff --quiet || [[ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]]; then
            git diff --check
            git add -A
            git commit -m "feat(auto): OpenAI fallback slice for #${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
            git push origin "HEAD:$WORK_BRANCH"
            if [[ -z "${EXISTING_PR:-}" ]]; then
              body=$(cat <<EOF
          Governed OpenAI second-fallback slice after safe Claude and Gemini provider failures.

          Provider: OpenAI fallback
          Claude classification: ${{ steps.claude_provider.outputs.kind }}
          Gemini classification: ${{ steps.gemini_provider.outputs.kind }}
          OpenAI exit status: ${status}

          Independent exact-head validation remains mandatory. No production mutation, taxonomy activation, scientific publication, sensitive-locality relaxation, credential change, spending action, or destructive operation was authorized.

          OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${ISSUE_NUMBER}
          OC-AUTO-REQUEUE: true
          OC-AUTO-BLOCKED: false
          EOF
              )
              gh pr create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --base "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH" --head "$WORK_BRANCH" --draft --title "OpenAI fallback: #${ISSUE_NUMBER} ${ISSUE_TITLE}" --body "$body" >/dev/null
            fi
            exit 0
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Classify OpenAI terminal state
        if: always() && steps.gemini_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed == 'true'
        id: openai_provider
        env:
          OPENAI_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.openai.outcome }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          kind=healthy
          if [[ "$OPENAI_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
            if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-status.txt" ]] && grep -q 'config_missing' "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-status.txt"; then
              kind=config
            elif grep -Eqi '(^|[^0-9])(401|403)([^0-9]|$)|unauthori[sz]ed|invalid[_ .-]?api[_ .-]?key|authentication (failed|required)|missing scopes?:|insufficient permissions?.*(api|operation)|api\.responses\.write' "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stderr.log" 2>/dev/null; then
              kind=security
            elif grep -Eqi '429|quota|rate.?limit|billing|credit|overloaded|service unavailable|temporarily unavailable|timeout|timed out|connection|websocket.*(reset|closed|failed)' "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-stderr.log" 2>/dev/null || [[ "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/openai-exit.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)" == "124" ]]; then
              kind=safe_provider
            else
              kind=unknown
            fi
          fi
          echo "kind=$kind" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "OpenAI classification: kind=$kind"

      - name: Classify lane result and release slot
        if: always() && steps.lease.outputs.execute == 'true'
        env:
          CLAUDE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.claude.outcome }}
          CLAUDE_KIND: ${{ steps.claude_provider.outputs.kind }}
          CLAUDE_FALLBACK: ${{ steps.claude_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed }}
          GEMINI_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.gemini.outcome }}
          GEMINI_KIND: ${{ steps.gemini_provider.outputs.kind }}
          GEMINI_FALLBACK: ${{ steps.gemini_provider.outputs.fallback_allowed }}
          OPENAI_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.openai.outcome }}
          OPENAI_KIND: ${{ steps.openai_provider.outputs.kind }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          marker="OC-AUTO-ISSUE: #${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          pr=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --base "$INTEGRATION_BRANCH" --limit 100 --json number,body --jq ".[] | select(.body != null and (.body | contains(\"$marker\"))) | .number" || true)
          pr=${pr%%$'\n'*}

          gh label create oc-runtime-backoff --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --color 6e7781 --description "Worker parked after provider-chain failure; retry only after recovery evidence" 2>/dev/null || true
          gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-running >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

          if [[ -n "$pr" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-queued --remove-label oc-blocked --remove-label oc-runtime-backoff --remove-label oc-repair --add-label oc-validating >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            head=$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json headRefName --jq '.headRefName')
            gh workflow run frontend-ci.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref "$head" >/dev/null
            gh workflow run calyx-matrix-005-validation.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref "$head" >/dev/null
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Lane delivered/updated integration PR #$pr and dispatched independent frontend validation. Provider state: Claude=${CLAUDE_KIND:-unknown}, Gemini=${GEMINI_KIND:-not-run}, OpenAI=${OPENAI_KIND:-not-run}." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_KIND" == "max_turns" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-runtime-backoff --remove-label oc-validating --add-label oc-repair >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude reached the bounded turn ceiling; provider runtime remains healthy. Issue moved to oc-repair for a narrower continuation." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_KIND" == "runtime_config" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-queued --remove-label oc-validating --remove-label oc-repair --add-label oc-runtime-backoff >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude action returned success without an SDK execution record. Classified runtime_config and parked fail-closed instead of treating the no-op as progress." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_FALLBACK" == "true" && "$GEMINI_OUTCOME" == "success" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-runtime-backoff --remove-label oc-validating --add-label oc-queued --add-label oc-repair >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude was safely unavailable; Gemini completed without durable changes. Returned to bounded repair without waiting for Claude recovery." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$GEMINI_FALLBACK" == "true" && "$OPENAI_OUTCOME" == "success" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-runtime-backoff --remove-label oc-validating --add-label oc-queued --add-label oc-repair >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude and Gemini were safely unavailable; OpenAI completed without durable changes. Returned to bounded repair." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_FALLBACK" == "true" && "$GEMINI_FALLBACK" != "true" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-queued --remove-label oc-validating --remove-label oc-repair --add-label oc-runtime-backoff >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude was safely unavailable, but Gemini failed with non-substitutable classification=${GEMINI_KIND:-unknown}. Failed closed; OpenAI was not attempted." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$GEMINI_FALLBACK" == "true" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-queued --remove-label oc-validating --remove-label oc-repair --add-label oc-runtime-backoff >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] All eligible providers were exhausted without durable work. Parked in oc-runtime-backoff without provider thrashing. OpenAI classification=${OPENAI_KIND:-unknown}." >/dev/null
          elif [[ "$CLAUDE_OUTCOME" != "success" ]]; then
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-queued --remove-label oc-validating --remove-label oc-repair --add-label oc-runtime-backoff >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Claude failed with non-fallback classification=${CLAUDE_KIND:-unknown}. Failed closed; no provider bypass attempted." >/dev/null
          else
            gh issue edit "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --remove-label oc-validating --remove-label oc-runtime-backoff --add-label oc-queued >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "[OC-AUTO] Preferred provider completed without a durable integration PR. Returned to the queue for a bounded retry." >/dev/null
          fi

name: Orchid Deterministic Dispatch

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issues_json:
        required: true
        type: string
      wave_hash:
        required: true
        type: string
      artifact_name:
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  context-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: node scripts/verify-autonomy-context.mjs

  lane:
    needs: context-contract
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix:
        issue: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.issues_json) }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/orchid-budgeted-completion-lane.yml
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      issue_number: ${{ format('{0}', matrix.issue) }}
      wave_hash: ${{ inputs.wave_hash }}
      artifact_name: ${{ inputs.artifact_name }}
      provider_authorized: true
